note: think_probe.py item set. Deliberately tiny: one exact-match reasoning item, one 1-word brevity item, one tool call, one executable code task. Each is scored per lever at a ROOMY budget (num_predict 4096, starved items escalated to 8192/16384) so the probe measures think-token DEMAND and lever equivalence, not a budget. SAMPLING IS DELIBERATELY NOT PINNED: the harness sends no sampling parameters, so every battery runs at the model's Modelfile temperature — the probe must measure under the same conditions. Probing at temperature 0 (v1 of this file) made qwen3.5:4b-mlx and granite4.2:3b loop past 16k tokens on bat_ball (the greedy-decoding 'endless repetition' Qwen/OpenAI document) and mis-classified them as unbounded. Editing this file changes its provenance hash and marks every stored think_profile stale.
